title: Booking Funnel Stencil
conversionGoal: Move qualified visitors into a booked time slot with clear expectations and trust signals.
notes: Normalized from premium booking and consultation-oriented landing patterns.
The scheduler is represented as a structural availability block rather than a real calendar integration.
Proof, objections handling, and reassurance remain explicit because they materially affect booking conversion.

sources.notes: Supplied the core hero, feature, testimonial, and CTA rhythm for top-of-funnel booking pages.
Added explicit split information plus form or action page structure relevant to booking handoff.
Confirmed proof, testimonial, FAQ, and CTA archetypes that remain useful in booking funnels.
